author: Unknown poster
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon
content:
LF people who can draw Pokemon

You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario.

I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS!

This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too!

MOP: GCash, like always

title: WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!
content:
**WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!**

**TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here!**

Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration?

**Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project!** Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome!

**JOB DETAILS**

Company: Turing

Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified)

Project Duration: 10–12 weeks

Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop

Digital Illustration & Sketching

Character Design & Cartooning

Composition, Color & Perspective

Creativity & Attention to Detail

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills

Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools

Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles

Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus

Able to work independently and meet deadlines

**YOUR ROLE**

Create high-quality character illustrations from references.

Develop creative variations while preserving character identity.

Adapt artwork to different artistic styles.

Refine designs based on project feedback.

Document creative choices and submit polished artwork.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**trabaheroph@gmail.com**

**Subject:** Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Attach your updated CV and **art portfolio** (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or personal website).

Shortlisted applicants will undergo portfolio review before onboarding.

**BE A TRABAHERO!**

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities
